title: Energy-Efficient Code Generation Using Large Language Models: A Systematic Literature Review
abstract: arXiv:2603.00989v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software engineering for code generation, completion, translation, and repair. While substantial research has examined the energy consumption and environmental impact of LLM training and inference, considerably less attention has been given to the energy efficiency of the code produced by these models. Existing studies are fragmented across different models, programming tasks, benchmarks, hardware platforms, and measurement methods, making it difficult to draw consistent conclusions about the energy efficiency of LLM-generated code. No systematic synthesis currently consolidates these findings or identifies common trends, gaps, and methodological inconsistencies. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic literature review of existing empirical studies on the energy efficiency of LLM-generated code. translated_title: 使用大语言模型进行能效代码生成：一项系统性文献综述
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在软件工程中越来越多地被用于代码生成、代码补全、代码翻译和代码修复。尽管已有大量研究考察了大语言模型训练和推理的能耗及其环境影响，但针对这些模型所生成代码的能效问题，所获得的关注却要少得多。现有研究分散于不同的模型、编程任务、基准测试、硬件平台和测量方法之间，导致难以就大语言模型生成代码的能效得出一致的结论。目前尚无系统性综述来整合这些研究发现，或识别该领域共同的趋势、研究空白与方法学上的不一致。为填补这一空白，我们对大语言模型生成代码能效的现有实证研究开展了系统性文献综述。我们考察了大语言模型在多大程度上能够生成能效高的代码、所使用的度量指标等相关问题。
tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述首次整合了大语言模型生成代码能效这一领域的分散研究，指出现有研究在模型、任务、基准与测量方法上缺乏一致性，并总结了该领域的研究趋势、空白与方法学差异。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a systematic literature review to consolidate fragmented empirical studies on the energy efficiency of LLM-generated code, identifying common trends, research gaps, and methodological inconsistencies across models, tasks, benchmarks, and measurement methods.
